title: ralph_spec — ralph's spec verdict with a residual-risk rating (docs/ralph C6, R5)
description: The ralph spec reviewer's output. It is review-merge's spec schema plus a required `risk`, because ralph has no review_fix to write fix_result.json: review_gate writes that file instead, and merge_gate's check 8 needs a risk to judge. Same decision and findings shape as spec. The gates only check decision; the schema enforces it (approve|findings|needs_human_review). _io is stamped by the server.

decision.description: approve: nothing worth changing. findings: at least one finding is warranted. needs_human_review: the inputs cannot be judged safely; makes fix_outcome unmergeable and ends the run at mark_needs_human.

summary.description: One or two sentences stating the verdict and why.

findings.description: The findings; [] when none. Only an `error` becomes a Task (R4); warning and info go into the PR report.

severity.description: How seriously this finding blocks merging. Only `error` blocks.

message.description: The requirement at stake, how the change misses or contradicts it, and what must change.

files.description: Repository-relative paths; may be empty but must be present.

line.description: The line of the finding, or null when it has no single line.

suggestion.description: The concrete remediation, noting any unresolved architecture decision.

risk.description: How much residual risk a human merging this PR is taking: 1 is nothing to worry about, 5 is do not merge without reading carefully (review_fix's rubric, which starts at 0; a change that needs nothing is `approve`, so there is no 0 here). merge_gate rejects a merge without it and blocks a rating above 3; a PR rated 3 or below that has no outstanding finding is merged automatically, so this number decides whether a human ever reads the change. Rate it honestly: do not inflate it to force review, and do not deflate it to force a merge.
